_comment: Copy this file to live-run.local.json and fill it in. That filename is gitignored.
Never commit a real key, and never paste one into an issue, a PR, or a transcript.
Two ways to authenticate. Fill in exactly one of `subscription` or `apiKey`.
_subscriptionComment: Preferred. No key lives in this file at all.
Run `CODEX_HOME=/absolute/path/to/codex-home codex login` once, then point at that home.
The run reuses that login the same way `npm run eval:basic:live` does.
_apiKeyComment: Alternative. Replace `subscription` above with this block if you would rather use a key.
This path is not yet proven end to end; see the live-run notes in README.md.
